baseline_models.focus_anchor: The passive opening verb and the construct phrase identifying the companions by the trench.
baseline_models.mechanism: The death branch supplies a terminal predicate, companionship supplies sustained association or charge, and the sunken-cleft branch supplies the concrete site. With the killer unexpressed, the clause can remain both a report of destruction and an imprecation that fixes doom upon a trench-defined collective.

activation_trace.role: Literal putting to death supplies the clause's terminal force while leaving report and malediction co-present in the passive form.
Sustained companionship, possession, or charge turns proximity to the trench into a durable corporate identity.
The elongated sunken cleft gives the collective's association a deliberately cut spatial center.

changed_reading.before: A group located by a trench was killed.
changed_reading.after: Terminal doom is pronounced upon a collective whose identity is constituted by sustained attachment to an engineered trench, without yet deciding whether the line reports their end or curses them toward it.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The combination of killing, companions as possessors or keepers, and the deliberately cut trench.
baseline_models.mechanism: A causative-neighbor branch of killing introduces exposure to death, while the companionship inventory includes possession, charge, and making one thing accompany another. Together they permit an operator reading: the named people are liable not because they merely stand near the trench but because they make it a lethal means. The form-distance of the exposure branch keeps this below the terminal-verdict baseline.

activation_trace.role: Exposure of another to killing supplies an operator-to-victim causal relation rather than a bare death location.
Close association that can include possession or charge makes the companions potential custodians of the trench.
Making something accompany, fit, or be carried along supports the inference that the trench was integrated into their action.
A cut, elongated depression supplies the constructed instrument around which custodianship operates.

changed_reading.before: The companions are inhabitants or victims incidentally associated with a pit.
changed_reading.after: The companions can be the trench's custodians, condemned for converting a cut in the earth into a means by which others are exposed to death.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The killing verb read beside the trench root's bodily wasting branch and companionship's durative association.
baseline_models.mechanism: The nonterminal subduing branch of killing and the flesh-hollowing branch of the trench root combine through sustained association. This yields a process model in which the trench does not only end life at an instant; it reduces force, body, and agency over time. The branch combination is visibly anchored but cross-domain and therefore remains exploratory.

activation_trace.role: Subduing until force is softened supplies an attritional rather than exclusively terminal action profile.
Durative attachment allows the trench relation to operate as a process rather than a momentary location.
Channeled wasting and recession of flesh materialize the trench as bodily hollowing.

changed_reading.before: The line names a punctual act of killing at a physical trench.
changed_reading.after: The line can also carry a prolonged technology of domination in which trench-association hollows bodies and softens resistance before or alongside death.

context_deltas.mechanism: Witnessing occurs before the focus as a witness/witnessed pair, inside the scene as the actors watch their own deed, and beyond it as knowing testimony. This distributed witness structure turns the agentless terminal utterance into an evidentiary verdict: omission of the killer does not mean absence of knowledge, and the seated perpetrators become evidence against themselves.

activation_trace.role: Literal death remains the verdict whose grounds the surrounding witness network supplies.
Collective association gives the testimony a corporate subject rather than isolated offenders.
Presence with seeing frames the focus in advance as an event held before witnesses.
The actors' own presence and observation make their spectatorship self-incriminating rather than neutral.
Knowledge-bearing declaration closes the evidentiary gap left by the passive focus verb.

structural_cues: The witness root brackets the focus, recurs inside the narrated deed, and recurs again in a universal predication.
The focus suppresses the killing agent while naming the condemned collective.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated presence, seeing, and knowledge around an agentless death predicate; I infer a distributed evidentiary frame that converts the opening into a verdict. A live alternative is that the witnesses only intensify visual scene-setting without juridical force.

changed_reading.before: The passive clause is an unsupported report or curse.
changed_reading.after: The clause is a verdict embedded in a complete witness system: the deed is seen from within, known from beyond, and the perpetrators' watching helps establish their own liability.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediate sequence specifies burning fire, fuel, a fire-site, fixed observers, surveillance, and deliberate action. Those cues activate the baseline custodianship model: the trench is a maintained apparatus requiring material input and supervision, and companionship names operational complicity rather than accidental co-location.

activation_trace.role: Exposure to killing supplies the apparatus's causal output and the operators' liability for it.
Possession, charge, and close association let the group be read as the installation's keepers.
The elongated cut supplies the engineered container of the apparatus.
Burning fire and its capacity to brand specify the trench's active destructive medium.
Material fuel implies replenishment and converts the fire from an incident into a sustained process.
A designated fire-site fits the focus trench as a built installation rather than open terrain.
Sitting for surveillance assigns the companions a supervisory station around the apparatus.
The production of an act makes the suffering an enacted operation, not an unattended natural event.

structural_cues: The fire-and-fuel phrase immediately continues the trench phrase.
The seated posture is located upon or over the apparatus, followed by a clause naming what they do to others.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a cut site, fire, consumable fuel, stationed watching, and deliberate action; I infer maintenance and supervision linking the companions causally to death. The live alternative is a spontaneous fire observed by people whose responsibility comes from approval rather than operation.

changed_reading.before: The trench is a place where killing happened and its companions are merely nearby.
changed_reading.after: The trench is a supervised, fuel-fed killing installation, and 'companions' names the durable operational relation that distributes guilt across those who build, feed, watch, and enact it.

context_deltas.mechanism: Heart-security and trusted assent are repeatedly named as the victims' defining state, while fault-finding and the testing of metal or persons supply the persecutors' counter-action. The subduing branch of killing is thereby sharpened: the trench functions as a coercive assay intended to soften or redirect conviction, with bodily death as means, threat, or failed conversion point.

activation_trace.role: Subduing until force yields provides the coercive objective beneath the terminal surface of killing.
The bounded cleft supplies the physical chamber in which pressure is applied.
Security and settled trust in the heart identify the inner state the violence attempts to dislodge.
Fault-finding and stigmatizing supply the social judgment that selects the targets before force is applied.
Assaying metal or a person turns the fire-trench into a test that seeks to expose what remains under heat.
Deflection from the right course supplies the intended directional result of the coercive test.

structural_cues: The same believing collective recurs across the witnessing, grievance, punishment, and reward sequence.
The exception construction in 85:8 isolates belief itself as the sole stated grievance.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies inward security, selective blame, assay, and deflection; I infer that physical killing is organized to break allegiance rather than serving as an end with no ideological demand. A live alternative is that the assay language only characterizes punishment and not an attempted conversion mechanism.

changed_reading.before: The trench companions kill bodies because they hate a group.
changed_reading.after: They operate a coercive assay aimed at conviction: fire tests and tries to redirect the secure heart, so bodily killing exposes the failure of the persecutors to master belief.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus gives doom before narrating the fire scene; later, burning punishment, overpowering seizure, and the paired capacity to begin and return create a reversal circuit. The passive opening can therefore be read proleptically: it announces the operators' terminal outcome in advance, while the destructive medium they administer returns against them at another scale.

activation_trace.role: Putting to death supplies the anticipatory outcome pronounced before the apparatus is described.
The fire-bearing cleft is the first-scale container whose destructive logic can later be reversed.
Flame recurs on the punishment side, materially echoing the medium controlled by the trench operators.
Overpowering seizure supplies the force that can execute the opening verdict against those who had held others.
Beginning explicitly paired with return supplies the first half of a temporal reversal structure.
Return after departure supplies the arrow by which administered violence can come back upon its administrators.

structural_cues: The focus verdict precedes the descriptive account of fire, fuel, sitting, and watching.
A later punishment phrase repeats the fire domain before the paired verbs of beginning and returning.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an early death predicate, later fire punishment, severe seizure, and a beginning/return pair; I infer a proleptic, measure-like reversal in which the operators' medium returns upon them. A live alternative is that the later punishment is independent recompense with no material mirroring of the trench.

changed_reading.before: The focus is only a past-tense report about an already completed killing.
changed_reading.after: The focus can be an anticipatory verdict: the narrative states the trench operators' end first, then shows the fire they control before that same destructive logic returns upon them.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later protected garden, water-cut channel, and the branch in which death itself can count as victory split physical killing from ultimate defeat. This does not erase the strong operator reading of the companions, but it keeps a secondary participant reading alive: those attached to the trench as its victims may be killed without being the ones finally ruined, while the operators can be doomed without dying in the narrated instant.

activation_trace.role: Literal killing supplies the bodily loss whose final valuation the later victory branch destabilizes.
Association remains broad enough at the isolated focus stage to preserve operator and affected-participant attachments as competing possibilities.
The earth-cut channel supplies the lethal spatial pole against which the garden's channels are contrasted.
Protective covering supplies a preserved destination that counters the trench's exposure.
A channel cut through earth by flowing water gives a life-bearing spatial counterpart to the fire-filled cleft.
The branch in which death or destruction can be called victory prevents physical killing from automatically meaning final loss.

structural_cues: The reward scene follows the paired punishments and gives the believing collective a protected, water-bearing destination.
The isolated focus does not lexically name either perpetrators or believers, although the following scene strongly pressures the companions toward the seated operators.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies literal killing, protected gardens, flowing channels, and a victory-through-death branch; I infer a separation between bodily death and final defeat. The live and stronger alternative is that the focus subject is exclusively the seated operators, with the believers never designated as companions of the trench.

changed_reading.before: Whoever is killed in the focus is necessarily the defeated party.
changed_reading.after: Physical killing and final ruin separate: a trench victim can die yet win, while an operator can remain seated through the scene yet already stand under the opening sentence of destruction.

context_deltas.mechanism: The trench is a local enclosure cut downward; the later behind-or-beyond cue and complete surrounding expand the topology outward. Those who control the inner container and station themselves around it are themselves contained from a side they do not command. The focus doom thus becomes a spatial reversal of enclosure as well as a verbal sentence.

activation_trace.role: Possessive association locates the companions on the controlling side of the inner enclosure.
The sunken cleft supplies the bounded inner space used to hold and expose others.
A side that can be behind, ahead, or otherwise beyond destabilizes the operators' assumption that they control every relevant direction.
Concrete surrounding places a larger boundary around those who arranged the trench boundary.
Enclosure through domination and destruction gives the outer boundary punitive force.

structural_cues: The operators are first positioned over the trench, whereas the later surrounding comes from beyond them.
The scene nests a local man-made boundary inside a comprehensive outer boundary.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a cut enclosure, an operator group stationed around it, and a later beyond-plus-surrounding construction; I infer a reversal in which the enclosers are enclosed. A live alternative is that the final surrounding denotes general knowledge or power without intentionally mirroring the trench's geometry.

changed_reading.before: The trench creates a one-way topology in which its companions surround helpless victims.
changed_reading.after: The topology is nested and reversible: the companions command the inner pit but are already surrounded from beyond, so their instrument models their own coming containment.

context_deltas.mechanism: The event becomes renewed report and public talk, passes through attempts to cover and deny truth, and ends in gathered recitation, a writing surface, and guarded preservation. This sequence reverses the killers' apparent power to erase: the trench becomes the permanent title attached to them, while the event they tried to terminate is converted into a durable counter-record.

activation_trace.role: Literal killing supplies the attempted terminal erasure that the later record refuses to let be final.
Durable association fixes the perpetrators to the trench as a lasting name of responsibility.
The cut in earth becomes the material event-sign around which the remembered title is organized.
Becoming the talk of people turns completed violence into an event that repeatedly re-enters public time.
Covering truth supplies the attempted epistemic erasure against which preservation operates.
Contradiction of truth supplies the active denial that the counter-record answers.
Recitation repeatedly voices the event and prevents silence from completing the work of killing.
A broad writing surface supplies durable inscription as the material counterpart to the trench's earth-cut trace.
Guarding and preserving keep the record from suffering the erasure attempted against the victims.

structural_cues: The question about whether the report has arrived reopens an event presented earlier in compressed form.
Covering and denial are followed by recitation and a guarded written locus.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies public report, truth-covering, denial, recitation, inscription, and preservation; I infer a counter-erasure mechanism that permanently attaches the trench to its operators. A live alternative is that the preserved recitation is asserted generally and does not specifically function as memorial repair for this event.

changed_reading.before: Killing ends the victims' presence and leaves the perpetrators in control of the account.
changed_reading.after: The attempted erasure fails: the event becomes recitable and guarded, while the perpetrators are permanently reduced to a title naming the very apparatus by which they tried to control memory and life.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it joins a non-dominant split mapping for the sky root to a visible-mark branch, the focus root's cheek-brand branch, and later fire and heat traces. It remains valid as a material analogy anchored directly in the trench root and the supplied burning context. Render it only as a latent marking echo, never as the lexical gloss of the sky or of the trench.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The trench root's branch of a brand placed on the cheek, attached to the named companions.

activation_trace.role: Collective association lets a physical mark become a durable social designation attached to the group.
A brand on the cheek supplies the focus-side bridge from an earth incision to an imposed bodily mark.
The split-mapped visible sign that makes a thing known contributes a marking analogy without replacing the source word's dominant mapping.
Burning fire together with branding supplies the process by which the trench can leave a visible trace.
Heat's alteration of color extends the mark from the immediate body to an enduring material trace.

changed_reading.before: The trench is only a container in which bodies are destroyed.
changed_reading.after: The trench can also be carried as a marking technology: heat inscribes bodies, the earth, and collective memory, while the perpetrators themselves acquire an indelible trench-name.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is a form-distant ethical analogy activated by the focus killing root's idiom for one who defeats winter by feeding and warming people. Immediate fire and fuel keep it anchored, but it should be rendered only as an inversion of heat's social use, not as a translation or historical claim about the companions.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The killing root's branch for defeating winter through feeding and warmth, set beside companions and a cut site.

activation_trace.role: The idiom of overcoming winter by sustaining and warming people supplies the prosocial function that the trench fire reverses.
Companionship supplies the social relation within which warmth could protect but is instead weaponized.
The constructed cleft localizes the reversal in a deliberately prepared communal site.
Actual burning turns potentially sustaining warmth into the means of death.
Fuel shows resources being organized to sustain destructive heat rather than vulnerable people.

changed_reading.before: Fire is merely the physical method of killing.
changed_reading.after: The scene also inverts hospitality: material that could keep a community alive through cold is deliberately gathered to make human beings die.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This cross-domain model treats road tracks, a watercourse, and a river-cut channel as material analogues of the focus cleft. The shared cutting and channel geometry anchors it, but downstream prose should call it an ecological or infrastructural reversal rather than claim that the trench literally was a road or riverbed.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The trench root's elongated-cleft and road-track branches.

activation_trace.role: An elongated cut supplies the common channel geometry shared by trench and river.
Road and track imagery activates the trench as a directed passage rather than only a static hole.
Fuel fills and drives the focus channel with combustion instead of movement or water.
A river cutting earth with flowing water supplies the restorative counterpart to the fire-filled trench.
A watercourse that clears a path reinforces the idea of a channel whose proper movement has been violently diverted.

changed_reading.before: The trench is a static pit filled with fire.
changed_reading.after: The trench is an anti-river and blocked passage: a cut that should conduct movement or water is fed with combustion, while the later flowing channels restore the life-bearing function of a cleft.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This reading activates the killing root's distant branch of complete mastery of a fact and applies it to the companions' case. It remains anchored in the focus verb and is independently supported by knowledge-bearing witness, complete cognitive enclosure, and fixed memory. Render it as a secondary resonance of epistemic closure, not as a substitute lexical parsing of the passive verb.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus killing root's branch of complete mastery by knowledge, within an agentless verdict.

activation_trace.role: Complete mastery of a fact supplies the possibility that the case is settled in knowledge as well as the people condemned to death.
The associative title fixes a definite collective as the object of that epistemic closure.
Declaration grounded in knowledge supplies evidentiary articulation for the settled case.
Complete enclosure in knowledge removes any hidden side from which the deed could escape accounting.
Fixity in memory keeps the mastered fact from decaying into uncertainty.

changed_reading.before: The focus settles only the companions' bodily fate.
changed_reading.after: It can also resonate as closure of their case: what they did is fully witnessed, cognitively surrounded, and fixed in memory, leaving no epistemic route of escape.

strongest_changes: Fire, fuel, stationed watching, and deliberate action turn a topographic trench into a supervised killing apparatus and companionship into distributed operational guilt.
Repeated witnessing turns the passive opening from an unsupported curse or report into an evidentiary verdict in which the perpetrators' own spectatorship testifies against them.
Security of heart, selective grievance, assay, and deflection reframe bodily killing as a coercive attempt to master conviction.
Returned fire and outer enclosure make the opening proleptic and spatially reversible: the enclosers are themselves enclosed.
Report, denial, recitation, inscription, and preservation defeat erasure by making the trench the perpetrators' permanent title and the event a durable counter-record.
summary.what_was_special: The focus sustained several live readings at once: terminal report, malediction, operator liability, attritional coercion, and a narrow victim-side death-as-victory echo. Non-dominant and distant branches also activated contained material models of branding, inverted warmth, diverted channels, and epistemic closure without being promoted to lexical glosses.
remaining_uncertainties: The passive opening does not itself decide among past report, imprecation, and proleptic verdict.
The following scene strongly favors the seated operators as the companions, but focus-only association and the victory-through-death branch preserve a weaker affected-participant echo.
The attrition, branding, winter-hospitality, channel, and epistemic models may be analogical activations rather than semantic contributions of the exact focus forms.
The beginning-and-return pair supports reversal, but the packet alone does not force the returned fire to mirror the trench material point for point.
